objects.name: Detection technique coverage: powershell-connect-to-internet-with-hidden-window
objects.description: The following analytic detects PowerShell commands using the WindowStyle parameter to hide the window while connecting to the Internet. This behavior is identified through Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) telemetry, focusing on command-line executions that include variations of the WindowStyle parameter.
